first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses both current declines—activation and onboarding completion—and is supported by two durable findings showing improved first-week activation, completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. Promotional pricing could counter the competitor, but its effect on long-term customer quality and revenue durability should not be assumed from acquisition lift alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying the self-serve onboarding flow. The verified evidence directly addresses the current completion and activation declines: shortened onboarding increased completion 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention 3%; SMB signup simplification increased activation 9% and qualified revenue 4%. Guardrails should include 30-day retention and qualified revenue because signup simplification previously reduced retention 1%, and its evidence has not replicated beyond SMB.
